narr: Scattered thunderstorms associated with low pressure and a surface trough produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of central and eastern Virginia.
ev: Traffic was slowed due to water over the road near the intersection of Frog Level Road and Route 301 (Richmond Turnpike).
There were many reports of high water across the city of Norfolk.
Water was covering the roadway at Monticello Avenue and East 26th Street.
Cars were stranded due to high water at Virginia Beach Boulevard and Tidewater Drive.
The west bound right lane and right shoulder at Interstate 64 at Mile Marker 294.1 in the city of Chesapeake near the High Rise Bridge were closed due to high water.
Traffic was delayed due to standing water on road near the intersection of Route 621 and Barlow Lane.
There were numerous reports of flooded roadways across the city of Chesapeake, especially in the Deep Creek area.
